safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Metformin is not documented anywhere in the Generated facts.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting metformin removes an important chronic medication from the record and could lead to incomplete medication reconciliation and missed consideration of diabetes-related factors (e.g., skin healing/infection risk). While it likely does not change the immediate dermatitis treatment, it can contribute to downstream prescribing and monitoring errors.
